summary.note: Gold SQL written from the sponsor's own hint field; both queries executed, result sets compared (execution match). No LLM judge. n=10 is the sponsor's example set — small, so treat as a smoke number, not a benchmark.

rows.pred: SELECT c.name, SUM(s.amount) as total_sales FROM companyx.clients c JOIN companyx.sales s ON c.id = s.client_id WHERE c.region = '서울' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(s.amount) AS total_revenue FROM companyx.sales s WHERE s.quarter = '2025-Q3'
SELECT AVG(s.amount) AS monthly_avg_revenue FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'security'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT e.name, e.salary FROM companyx.employees e JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀' AND e.is_active = true

SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(p.id) AS project_count
FROM companyx.clients c
JOIN companyx.projects p ON c.id = p.client_id
WHERE p.status = 'in_progress'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY project_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT st.title, st.description, st.priority, st.status, st.created_at, e.name AS assignee_name, c.name AS client_name, p.name AS product_name FROM companyx.support_tickets st JOIN companyx.employees e ON st.assignee_id = e.id JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id JOIN companyx.products p ON st.product_id = p.id WHERE st.priority = 'critical' AND st.status IN ('open', 'in_progress') ORDER BY st.created_at DESC
SELECT p.name AS 제품명, SUM(c.amount) AS 총계약금액 FROM companyx.products p JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 총계약금액 DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE is_active = true AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM registered_at) = 2024
SELECT d.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary FROM companyx.departments d JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(s.amount) AS total_revenue FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id WHERE c.region = '부산' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_date) = 2025

SELECT 'cloud' AS category, SUM(s.amount) AS amount FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'cloud' AND s.region = '대전' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_date) = 2025 UNION ALL SELECT 'security' AS category, SUM(s.amount) AS amount FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'security' AND s.region = '대전' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_date) = 2025 ORDER BY category
SELECT (p2.price_monthly - p1.price_monthly) AS price_diff FROM companyx.products p1, companyx.products p2 WHERE p1.name = 'Product-D1' AND p2.name = 'Product-D2'
SELECT name AS 제품명, version AS 버전, release_date AS 출시일 FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-C4'
SELECT c.name, c.contact_name, c.contact_email FROM companyx.clients AS c WHERE c.id = 14
SELECT e.name, e.hire_date FROM companyx.employees e WHERE e.hire_date = '2024-07-01' AND e.is_active = true
SELECT e.name, e.salary FROM companyx.employees e WHERE e.salary >= 4000 AND e.salary < 5000 AND e.is_active = true
SELECT st.title, st.created_at, c.name AS client_name FROM companyx.support_tickets st JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id WHERE st.priority = 'critical' AND st.status = 'open'

SELECT st.created_at, st.resolved_at FROM companyx.support_tickets st JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Client-X' AND st.product_id IN (SELECT id FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-C1')

SELECT st.title, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) AS duration_seconds
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
WHERE st.status IN ('resolved', 'closed')
  AND st.created_at >= '2025-01-01'
ORDER BY duration_seconds DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.name AS customer_name, contract.end_date FROM companyx.contracts AS contract JOIN companyx.clients AS c ON contract.client_id = c.id WHERE contract.status = 'active' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM contract.end_date) = 2026 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM contract.end_date) = 10

SELECT c.name AS client_name, p.name AS product_name, amount, start_date, end_date FROM companyx.contracts ct JOIN companyx.clients c ON ct.client_id = c.id JOIN companyx.products p ON ct.product_id = p.id WHERE c.name = 'Client-B' AND ct.contract_type = 'subscription'
SELECT p.budget, p.start_date FROM companyx.projects p JOIN companyx.clients c ON p.client_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Client-E' AND p.name LIKE '%로그 분석 시스템%'
SELECT p.name FROM companyx.projects AS p WHERE p.status = 'on_hold' AND p.end_date IS NULL
SELECT c.name AS 회사명, c.region AS 지역 FROM companyx.clients c WHERE c.industry = '의료/바이오' AND c.is_active = true
SELECT c.name, c.registered_at FROM companyx.clients AS c ORDER BY c.registered_at ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT s.sale_date, s.amount FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.name = 'Product-S2' AND s.quarter = '2025-Q1'
SELECT e.name, e.salary, e.hire_date FROM companyx.employees e WHERE e.name = '김준혁'
SELECT contract_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM companyx.contracts WHERE start_date >= '2025-01-01' AND end_date IS NULL AND status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY contract_type

SELECT s.sale_date, SUM(s.amount) as total_amount FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id WHERE c.region = '서울' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_date) = 2026 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sale_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 GROUP BY s.sale_date ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1
